title: Realize compatible faces by a split-attachment functor
statement: For a split n-truncated simplicial formal family K and a formal family V with compatible boundary cone p [def-weil-pbc-site-split-attachment-data], there exists an (n+1)-truncated simplicial formal family L with strict old restriction K and top family attachedFamily K V. For every lower ordinal face α, the new inclusion followed by L(α) is p(α), and the old summand (r,σ,i) followed by L(α) is the component of K(α≫σ) at i. A proper top epi concatenates σ with the normalized old label, and every component of this epi operator is invertible.

source.place: Tags 0DAV (lemma-hypercovering-object), construction and omitted composition verification, and 0DAU (lemma-split); explicit normalized-coordinate expansion of the finite attachment argument.

proof.text: Use attachmentTerm and attachmentMap as the object and morphism maps of L. attachmentMap_id and attachmentMap_comp give the functor laws. Functor.hext gives the strict restriction equality: the old pieces are precisely K. The top family equality is the piecewise definition.

On new and old summands, the prescribed face equations are hom_ext applied to the two clauses of attachFace. For epis, attachLift_epi reduces to attachEpi, giving the displayed normalized index equation. The component isomorphism assertion is attachmentMap_epi_component_iso.
